backup.production_rule: No table or column change: one job_heartbeats row (expire-cleaning-photos-weekly) and one pg_cron job. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, re-read the clock, then fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs does it). Deploy the Edge Function expire-cleaning-photos from waves BEFORE applying: the cron's first call is the following Sunday 22:00 UTC, and until then it only ever finds sessions older than 90 days with their own storage folder (none before 2026-12-12).

forward_verification.name: heartbeat_row_seeded_eight_day_interval
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(expected_interval_seconds = 691200 and ops_risk = false) from public.job_heartbeats where job_name = 'expire-cleaning-photos-weekly'

forward_verification.name: cron_job_scheduled_sunday_2200_utc_with_delete_flag
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(active and schedule = '0 22 * * 0' and command like '%/functions/v1/expire-cleaning-photos?delete=1%') from cron.job where jobname = 'expire-cleaning-photos-weekly'

forward_verification.name: cron_reads_the_secret_from_vault_never_embeds_it
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(command like '%cascade_cron_shared_secret%' and command !~ 'x-cascade-cron-secret''\s*,\s*''[^(]') from cron.job where jobname = 'expire-cleaning-photos-weekly'

forward_verification.name: no_cleaning_photo_object_removed_by_the_release
forward_verification.query: select count(*) >= 300 from storage.objects where bucket_id = 'cleaning-photos'

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Apply supabase/rollbacks/20261006_cleaning_photo_expiry.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it unschedules the weekly job and removes its heartbeat row. To stop a run in flight, unschedule first. Photos the function already removed from Storage are in Drive (it removes only a copy Drive holds) and are not restored by this.

feature_flags.name: function_then_sql
feature_flags.required_state: Deploy expire-cleaning-photos (no JWT verification, like power-watch) before this release; the function deletes only with ?delete=1 and a call without the flag is a dry run that deletes and tells nobody. Redeploy verify-meter-photo, resend-cleaning-report and submit-cleaning from the same waves commit.

compatibility.rehearsal: NOT RUN (session 72 lane L9 has no Postgres here). Orchestrator: restore the newest backup into a rehearsal copy, apply the migration (1/1; the cron block skips there because pg_cron is absent), run pgTAP cleaning_photo_expiry (10 tests; the last 3 skip without pg_cron).
compatibility.evidence: Production read-only 2026-10-06: job_heartbeats has no expire-cleaning-photos-weekly row; record_job_heartbeat refuses unknown names and the error-code check allows REMOVE_FAILED and RUN_FAILED; cleaning-photos holds 380 objects under property/user/submission folders (2026-09-12 onward) and about 335 in legacy YYYY-MM-DD folders that the function never touches; 39 of 48 sessions have a complete Drive archive; none of the 39 with a per-session folder is older than 90 days, so the first real run that can delete anything is Monday 2026-12-14.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty or still the PENDING placeholder
the rehearsal has not run the pgTAP suite green on this commit
the expire-cleaning-photos function is not deployed yet
